CẤM dùng field audience_size cua search_interests lam so 'global' de tinh ty le US/global — 2 he do KHAC METHOD (bang chung: Pickleball search_global 1.03M < US_reach 15.25M => vo ly). search_interests audience_size = deprecated/unreliable, chi giu de tra interest_id. Bot doc file nay moi ngay, goi lai estimate cho tung id, ghi Δ vs last_run.
